company.name: MinusX
company.shortDescription: MinusX provides an AI data scientist who integrates with Metabase to analyze business data.
company.description: MinusX provides an AI data scientist who integrates with Metabase to analyze business data. The platform handles ad-hoc data requests and answers questions directly on dashboards. The system allows users to create and query data catalogs without redefining metrics. It operates locally on the browser, ensuring that raw data does not leave the system and meets SOC 2 and GDPR compliance. The platform offers different plans for individuals, teams, and enterprises, including support, data integrations, and advanced training services.
